run_type: local Fake X composition regression; not a formal allocation
backend: repository-owned guarded Fake X fixture plus an independent JSON Fake X state/effect oracle
composed_arms: current generation; one release effect; independently checked Fake X key-up state; runtime release remains UNKNOWN
stale generation; no release effect; key remains down
supervisor blocked beyond absolute transaction deadline; caller responds within target; helper retirement attempted; no Fake X effect; runtime remains UNKNOWN
pass_rule: All selected tests pass in normal and optimized Python; public cancel response remains below 450 ms in the composed cases; pending/terminal cancellation remains distinct from the action; no timeout or stale case sets release_confirmed/task_success or permits replay; Fake X oracle agrees with each effect decision.
failure_rule: Any false release/task-success claim, replay permission, duplicate effect, accepted stale/expired effect, unretained cancellation operation, event-loop stall beyond the response target, or test failure is FAIL.
scope_limit: This does not exercise the production X11 worker against Xlib/Xvfb, does not prove X server queue drainage or refusal of already queued late effects, does not prove hard OS process-termination bounds, and is not WSLc, physical input, MAP01, independent real-application task success, efficiency, or reliability evidence.
